censor_denominator: All outer selection settlements, including no-group/unselected events; censoring is not run failure and is excluded only from cumulative/window learning memory.

cost_scope.manager_launch_wall: Includes wrapper and coordinator exit; manager verification is outside scientific budget.
cost_scope.nested_timing_rule: Do not add selection, log, native, worker and entry wall intervals. Sums across sequential jobs are descriptive batch resource totals.
cost_scope.observed_cpu: Coordinator self CPU plus reaped descendant user+system CPU; descendants already include native CPU, so native/worker/selection/log CPU is not added again.
cost_scope.success_admission_wall: Process entry through worker result output, external final validation, and artifact hashing; excludes coordinator receipt write/exit.
cost_scope.unknown_concurrency_limit: Recorded execution is serial; no independent host-load telemetry was recorded.

decision.committed_cumulative: Do not expand as a demonstrated performance contribution: three SOC wins, two losses, seven ties; maze n16 mean SOC worsens by one, maze n32 improves by three, both random tasks tie. No stable multi-task benefit.
decision.next_work: Close this authorized batch. Any new scientific scope needs a separate explicit proposal and authorization; recovery/training/world/thesis are outside this batch.
decision.semantic_contract: Keep auditable committed-outcome/censor semantics as an engineering contract, separately from unsupported quality claims.
decision.window16: Stop: only one SOC win against three losses and eight ties; no makespan win. Do not tune W or add seeds to seek positive cases.

fairness.top_k: number of vehicles in the same task

implementation: Independent Python standard-library arithmetic, path geometry and per-seed history reconstruction; no project verifier imported and no executable planner invoked.
limitations: Four historical tasks on two maps, with three seeds nested within each task; no significance or generalization claim.

Intermediate candidate paths and actual author posterior values were not logged; audit verifies recorded candidate arithmetic/flags and final full geometry, not independently reconstructing every intermediate candidate or author posterior.
Outcome-dependent budget censoring is not an unbiased success-rate sample.
The fixed primary endpoint is SOC; makespan can worsen versus the initial plan even when SOC improves.
